Personality: Vartin is a young Vlandian lord whose conduct stands in stark opposition to the chivalric ethos of his culture. Taking pragmatism as his guiding creed, he pursues personal gain at any cost, viewing honor and generosity as dispensable burdens. Lacking courage, he prefers to avoid direct confrontation, yet on the battlefield his cunning and tactical flair are not to be underestimated. Superb scouting skills allow him to anticipate enemy movements, while his exceptional charm makes him a smooth talker adept at coaxing allies and deceiving foes alike. Vartin is proficient in a variety of combat skills—especially throwing weapons and archery—and excels in horsemanship and agility, allowing him to thrive in battle even as he prefers to exploit these advantages from a safe distance. He is a shrewd, selfish survivalist who will cast aside any moral scruple for the sake of his clan and his own interests.
Background: Vartin hails from Clan dey Jelind of Vlandia, and though his family history may not be illustrious, his extraordinary survival instincts and cunning methods enabled him to join the ranks of the lords by the age of twenty-seven. His early years were filled with shadowy gray areas; his high roguery skill hints that he once operated beyond the law and even had deep dealings with bandits or the underworld, giving him a unique edge in Vlandia's power struggles. He pledges allegiance to King Derthert, though that loyalty stems more from calculated self-interest than blind chivalry. Vartin excels at employing strategy and reconnaissance on the battlefield, consistently providing Derthert with vital intelligence and using flexible tactics to compensate for the limitations of traditional Vlandian heavy cavalry. His marriage to Lietgardis is likely yet another calculated move to consolidate his position.
